item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Make My Photo Reel Fun

turns.text: Turn these five pics into an 8-second vertical reel. Make it fun! You pick the vibe.

item.tests: Checks whether the agent turns a vague creative brief into a visibly playful photo reel without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 8 seconds.
All five attached photos appear recognizably: the golden retriever, shocked cat, beach friends, curly-haired woman and mountain lake.
The edit includes visible playful treatment, such as bouncy motion, comic timing, lively transitions or humorous overlays, rather than only static slides.
Faces and the pets remain recognizable and are not obscured throughout their appearances.
The result is a single edited sequence, not five separate clips or a contact sheet.

turns.text: Could you turn all five attached pictures—the dog pic, the surprised cat pic, the two friends pic, the woman's portrait, and the lake pic—into a reel for me? I thought it would be nice to do something with these pictures instead of just leaving them sitting around. What I mean is one 8-second vertical 9:16 reel using the whole set. Make it fun, and you can pick the vibe, the order, the editing style, any music, sound effects or voice, and any captions, wording or language. I'm curious to see what you come up with because I don't really have a particular vision in mind.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the reel because Magic Hour refused the request for **insufficient credits**. No video was created.

The concept is ready: **“Camera roll, but make it a mini adventure”**—one 8-second, 9:16 reel using all five photos:

- **Dog:** “GOOD VIBES”
- **Surprised cat:** “PLOT TWIST”
- **Two friends:** “MY PEOPLE”
- **Woman’s portrait:** “MAIN CHARACTER”
- **Lake:** “MORE OF THIS”

The planned style is playful scrapbook cuts, gentle photo zooms, upbeat instrumental music, and a comic pop on the cat reveal. Generation will need enough Magic Hour credits to proceed.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create ONE eight-second vertical 9:16 fun photo montage reel using ALL FIVE supplied reference photos, not substitutes. Preserve the exact subjects and likenesses in the photos. Treat photos as photographic cutouts/cards with subtle pan/zoom, not morphing people or animals. Vibe: playful camera-roll mini adventure, bright scrapbook editorial, snappy beat-synced hard cuts, tasteful white borders and tiny sticker stars. Timeline: 0.0-1.5s @dog full photo card with gentle punch-in, caption 'GOOD VIBES'; 1.5-2.8s @cat surprised cat, quick comic punch-in, caption 'PLOT TWIST'; 2.8-4.4s @friends show BOTH friends together with faces fully visible, photo fitted within vertical frame over a blurred matching background, caption 'MY PEOPLE'; 4.4-5.8s @portrait woman photo with subtle parallax and warm sparkle, caption 'MAIN CHARACTER'; 5.8-8.0s @lake wide lake landscape fitted in vertical canvas with soft matching background, gentle zoom out, caption 'MORE OF THIS'. Use each of the five photos clearly and separately in this order. Keep captions large simple white sans-serif with dark shadow, within safe margins. No new people, no face changes, no talking. Audio: cheerful bouncy instrumental indie-pop beat with light percussion and plucky guitar, short whoosh transitions, a tiny comic pop on the cat cut, resolving with soft water ambience over lake. No voice or lyrics. Exactly 8 seconds.
